mars.x: Desert home of the ancient non-human Martian Old Ones in Stranger in a Strange Land, and capital city Marsopolis in Double Star.

pluto.x: Remote scientific outpost and alien staging ground in Have Space Suit—Will Travel, and fleet monitoring post in Starship Troopers.

hip-91262.x: Vega system, home to the benign advanced alien civilization of the Mother-Thing and station of the Three Galaxies federation tribunal.

b.s: Key Solar System and stellar destinations across Robert A. Heinlein’s Future History and standalone classics, from the lunar penal colony in The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress to Mars in Stranger in a Strange Land and Pluto in Have Space Suit—Will Travel.
